title: Planning an AI Assistant for Your Business: What to Decide Before Anything Is Built

facebook.message:
Thinking about an AI assistant but not sure where to start?
Our latest guide covers what to settle before anything is built:
• Pick one narrow, low-risk job rather than a helper for everything
• Decide which documents it may draw on, and what it must never do
• Name the person who checks its output before anyone relies on it

To read the full article, visit the FinTaxTech website and find "Planning an AI Assistant for Your Business: What to Decide Before Anything Is Built" in our Blog section.
#AIAutomation #SmallBusiness

instagram.caption:
An AI assistant works best when the planning comes first.
Before anything is built, a business owner can settle a few plain questions, so the project starts from a clear brief rather than a vague hope.
→ Start with one narrow, repeatable, low-risk job
→ Choose approved sources and leave out anything out of date
→ Write down what the assistant must never do
→ Name a person to check every output
→ Confirm who owns what, in writing
